From the second he welcomed myself and my son with his huge smile and friendly demeanor I knew we were in safe hands. Julian took the time to listen to my concerns, taking a full medical history of my son and at each step showing me what ailment he had, what medications were available and putting my anxiety at ease by completing a full check of his heart. (My son has a heart condition)
Julian was the first and only medical professional to have ever done that at a gp surgery to put my mind at ease. THANKYOU!
On our second visit I was able to request Julian again for continuity of care. Again he was chatty, super kind and friendly and worked with me to put together a new medical plan for my son. I wouldnt hesitate to recommend Julian to anyone who needs to visit their gp practice and will be requesting him from now on. My only criticism is that he cannot be cloned and be at both Boyatt Wood and Eastleigh Medical Practice.
Please pass on my thanks and gratitude to a super human being. You really do have a diamond in the rough with him.

Thankyou in advance,
